title: Prime Minister's Office (Monetary Authority of Singapore)
what_it_is: Prime Minister's Office (Monetary Authority of Singapore)

sections.label: MAS eased monetary policy
sections.summary: MAS eased monetary policy in April to prevent broadening disinflationary pressures that would be destabilising for the economy.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
sentences.text: MAS eased monetary policy in April this year to prevent a broadening of disinflationary pressures that would be destabilising for the economy.

sections.label: MAS support package launch
sections.summary: In April 2020, MAS launched a $125 million support package including enhanced subsidies for training and manpower costs in financial services and FinTech.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
sentences.text: In April 2020, MAS launched a $125 million support package, which included enhanced subsidies for training and manpower costs in the financial services and FinTech sectors.

sections.label: SGUnited traineeships for graduates
sections.summary: Close to 60 FIs have offered close to 1,300 SGUnited traineeships to fresh graduates.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
sentences.text: Close to 60 FIs have offered close to 1,300 SGUnited traineeships to fresh graduates.

sections.label: MAS FSTI 2.0 scheme
sections.summary: MAS recently announced a $250 million enhanced Financial Sector Technology and Innovation Scheme, FSTI 2.0, to accelerate technology and innovation-driven growth.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
sentences.text: MAS recently announced a $250 million enhanced Financial Sector Technology and Innovation Scheme, or FSTI 2.0, to accelerate technology and innovation-driven growth in the sector.

sections.label: Green finance vision and priorities
sections.summary: MAS set out its vision for Singapore as a leading global centre for green finance and will press on with its Green Finance Action Plan.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
sentences.text: MAS set out our vision for Singapore to be a leading global centre for green finance last November.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
sentences.text: We have made good progress and will continue to press on with all three pillars of our Green Finance Action Plan, to strengthen the financial sector’s resilience to environmental risks, develop green finance markets and solutions, and harness technology and innovation to promote green finance.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
sentences.text: MAS' priorities are to ensure monetary and financial stability, support individuals and businesses to tide through the crisis, and position the financial sector for recovery and future growth.
